summary: Evaluate evidence for one declared learned interatomic-potential use through traceable labels, independent domain-aware evaluation, and claim-relevant property checks.
triggers: A learned interatomic potential needs evaluation before use for a declared materials domain.
An adapted or fine-tuned potential needs target-domain and retained-domain evidence.
A model claim depends on chemistry, structure, condition, property, or execution-path transfer.
antiTriggers: Train or fine-tune a model, run GPU work, or acquire new DFT labels.
Construct platform-specific DFT inputs or submit scientific-computing jobs.
Infer experimental accuracy, universal transferability, or deployment certification from model-reference agreement alone.
Analyze corrosion experiments, electrochemistry, free-energy reweighting, or excited-state chemistry.
